question: Should device-auth clients use the Gateway-provided challenge timestamp as `signedAt` while retaining the current nonce and freshness checks?
rationale: This is the narrowest demonstrated repair, but it changes a replay-sensitive authentication contract shared by native and TypeScript clients and therefore needs explicit owner confirmation.

options.title: Use Challenge Time
options.body: Use validated `connect.challenge.ts` across affected clients and add coverage for skewed clocks, malformed timestamps, and stale challenges.

options.title: Keep Client Time
options.body: Retain local-clock signing and improve native clock-correction guidance, accepting that pairing remains blocked during real clock skew.

recommendation.title: Use Challenge Time
recommendation.body: Use validated `connect.challenge.ts` across affected clients and add coverage for skewed clocks, malformed timestamps, and stale challenges.

likelyOwner.reason: This login introduced both the unified device-auth and nonce-bound challenge contracts and is the strongest history owner for this security boundary.
